name: housecallpro-mcp
description: Read estimates a Housecall Pro contractor sent you, and decline options you don't want.
long_description: Reads the customer-side Housecall Pro portal from the per-document link your contractor emailed or texted you: estimate line items, totals, tax, and the company behind it. Declining an option is supported and confirm-gated. Approving is not automatable — Housecall Pro gates it behind a reCAPTCHA only the real page can produce.

link.title: Customer link
link.description: The estimate or invoice link your contractor sent you (pro.housecallpro.com/mobile_estimate/… or client.housecallpro.com/estimates/…).
